info.about: Super Ghouls 'n Ghosts, known as Chō Makaimura in Japan, is a 1991 platform video game developed and published by Capcom for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System.
info.trivia: The Game Boy Advance version adds an Arrange Mode with redesigned stages and bosses drawn from Ghosts 'n Goblins and Ghouls 'n Ghosts.
info.why: Arrange Mode exists only on this cartridge, which gives owners of the 1991 SNES original a reason to buy the game a second time.
